name: Fated List of Minor Prophecies
description: The Fated List of Minor Prophecies is the in-game checklist on the Fates' loom in the House. It names 55 goals and rewards each one, but it never shows how much of a goal is left.

name: Platform Achievements
description: Platform achievements, awarded by Steam and the other stores. There are 50: 49 ordinary ones plus a 50th for earning the other 49, which is why Steam lists only 49 publicly.

name: Codex
description: The Codex is the book Achilles gives you. It catalogues every character, weapon, foe, artifact, fish, region and companion you meet, and a character's entry fills with hearts as your affinity grows.

name: Keepsakes
description: A keepsake is an item a character gives you after your first gift of Nectar. You equip one per run for its benefit, and it ranks up to 3 as you carry it through encounters.

name: Weapon Aspects
description: An Aspect is an alternate form of a weapon, bought with Titan Blood at the weapon rack. Every weapon has four, and each levels from 1 to 5. An Aspect changes how the weapon plays, not only its numbers.

name: Boons
description: A boon is a power an Olympian offers during a run. You lose the ones you hold when you die, but the tracker records every one you have ever been offered and taken.

name: Daedalus
description: A Daedalus enchantment comes from a Daedalus Hammer found during a run and upgrades your weapon for that run only. What is permanent is having taken it once, so the tracker counts 12 per weapon.

name: Mirror of Night
description: The Mirror of Night sits in your bedroom. You spend Darkness on permanent upgrades that apply to every future run. Each of the 12 talents has a red side and a green side, and only one is active at a time.

name: Pact of Punishment
description: The Pact of Punishment is the difficulty menu at the door out of the House. Switching a Condition on makes the run harder and raises your Heat, which unlocks better rewards.

name: Perks
description: These are the abilities foes gain when the Benefits Package Pact condition is active. Each one changes how a foe behaves, and the Fated List asks you to slay a foe carrying each.

name: Well of Charon
description: The Well of Charon is the vending machine that appears in a chamber during a run. You pay Obols for an item that lasts that run only, so what the tracker records is having ever bought each one.
